title: Autoscaffold: Diagnostic Surgeon + Call Attenuation for Noisy Alerts
author: Priya Desai
release_notes: Adds an auto-scaffolded diagnostic surgeon workflow that assembles dependency probes, safe ephemeral probes, and an attenuation policy to reduce noisy alert fatigue. Includes new CLI commands and web actions in the incident-bot UI. Backwards-compatible feature flag 'diagnostic_surgeon' behind rollout.
description: Motivation: On-call teams see repeated noisy alerts from cascading downstream failures. This PR adds 'Autoscaffold Diagnostic Surgeon' — a coordinated small-footprint diagnostic choreography that (1) runs a prioritized lattice of dependency probes, (2) collects lightweight evidence bundles, (3) suggests a minimal remediation or attenuation action, and (4) can optionally apply safe call attenuation (throttling noisy alert sources) under SRE-approved rules. Design: The surgeon is an orchestrator that composes pre-registered probe steps (tcp/ping/http/trace-span-sampler/log-tail) with failure scoring. It scaffolds a one-click playbook entry in the incident-bot UI and emits a compact evidence package for postmortem and evals. Shipped behind feature flag 'diagnostic_surgeon' with a conservative rollout (10% orgs -> 50% -> 100%). Checklist: - [x] Probe definitions and template library - [x] Safe attenuation policy engine with TTL and audit log - [x] UI scaffolding and CLI support - [x] Tests for probe isolation & resource quotas - [x] Metrics/alerts for surgeon error rate and attenuation impact - [x] Linear tickets filed for rollout and docs Impact: Expected to reduce repeated alert noise for ~10% of high-churn pages and to lower mean-time-to-diagnose by surfacing immediate dependency health. Rollout plan: enable flag for internal SRE team, run for 72h with additional telemetry (surgeon.invocations, attenuation.applied, probe.latencies, evidence.size). If attenuation.applied rate > 20% or surgeon.error_rate > 1%, pause rollout and revert flag. Rollback: feature flag off, attenuation engine will revoke active attenuations by TTL expiry; manual revoke CLI added. Privacy/security: evidence bundles are sanitized by default (no PII) and stored encrypted. Backwards compatibility: non-enabled orgs see no UI changes. Notes: This PR purposefully keeps probe types limited and resource-capped to avoid noisy storms; follow-ups will add adaptive backoff and ML-ranked probe ordering.
